chunks: And ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about tayammum in place of wudu (ablution), and from janābah, and from menstruation for women—whether it is the same.

key_terms.التَّيَمُّمِ: dry ablution performed as a substitute for water-based purification
key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: the same or equal in ruling

ai.seo_question: Is tayammum performed the same way for wudu (ablution), janābah, and menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that tayammum is the same in form for replacing wudu (ablution), for janābah, and for menstruation in the case of women. It indicates a shared ruling in ritual purification when tayammum is performed as a substitute.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.216 - Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about tayammum for wudu (ablution), janabah (major ritual impurity), and menstruation for women.
Imam (as) said: 'Yes, it is the same.'
